records.Name: CPQQuoteProposalDocumentSteppedUpPricing
records.FormulaConverted: | var:UngroupedLine:QuoteLineType "Cancellation" = | var:UngroupedLine:LineDescription | | | var:UngroupedLine:LineDescription ISBLANK NOT "/\/\/" "" IF "(" var:UngroupedLine:QuoteLineType ")" CONCAT | var:UngroupedLine:QuoteLineType "Quantity/\/\/Increase" = | var:UngroupedLine:LineDescription | | | var:UngroupedLine:LineDescription ISBLANK NOT "/\/\/" "" IF "(" var:UngroupedLine:QuoteLineType ")" CONCAT | var:UngroupedLine:QuoteLineType "Quantity/\/\/Reduction" = | var:UngroupedLine:LineDescription | | | var:UngroupedLine:LineDescription ISBLANK NOT "/\/\/" "" IF "(" var:UngroupedLine:QuoteLineType ")" CONCAT | var:UngroupedLine:LineDescription "/\/\/" + var:UngroupedLine:RateDetails + "" CONCAT IF IF IF
records.FormulaExpression:
IF(
    UngroupedLine:QuoteLineType = "Cancellation",
    CONCAT(UngroupedLine:LineDescription,
    IF(
        NOT(ISBLANK(UngroupedLine:LineDescription)),
        " ",
        ""
    ),
    "(", UngroupedLine:QuoteLineType, ")"),
    IF(
        UngroupedLine:QuoteLineType = "Quantity Increase",
        CONCAT(UngroupedLine:LineDescription,
        IF(
            NOT(ISBLANK(UngroupedLine:LineDescription)),
            " ",
            ""
        ),
        "(", UngroupedLine:QuoteLineType, ")"),
        IF(
            UngroupedLine:QuoteLineType = "Quantity Reduction",
            CONCAT(UngroupedLine:LineDescription, 
            IF(
                NOT(ISBLANK(UngroupedLine:LineDescription)),
                " ",
                ""
            ),
            "(", UngroupedLine:QuoteLineType, ")"),
            CONCAT(UngroupedLine:LineDescription + " " + UngroupedLine:RateDetails,"")
        )
    )
)
